description: This is a C# source file containing unit tests for the AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer in the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It tests detection of conflicts between alias attributes used on various types, interfaces, methods, etc., within Orleans grain interfaces. The tests verify that duplicate alias values trigger diagnostics, ensuring proper alias uniqueness in Orleans serialization and RPC.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer, testing detection of alias conflicts across different code constructs.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Confirms that the analyzer detects a diagnostic for code with duplicate aliases.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Confirms that the analyzer does not detect a diagnostic for code with unique aliases.
